# Membrane Transcoder plugin v0.4.1 - Table of Contents

> Transcoder plugin for Membrane Framework

## Pages

- [Membrane Transcoder Plugin](https://membrane-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.Transcoder](https://membrane-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Transcoder.md): Provides transcoding capabilities for audio and video streams in Membrane.
- [Membrane.Transcoder.Video.ConstantBitrate](https://membrane-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Transcoder.Video.ConstantBitrate.md): Defines encoder setting for constant bitrate rate control algorithm.
- [Membrane.Transcoder.Video.VariableBitrate](https://membrane-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Transcoder.Video.VariableBitrate.md): Defines encoder setting for variable bitrate rate control algorithm.
